title: Output at a pivotal coordinate
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be monotone, and let $i$ be a coordinate and $x$ an input. If flipping coordinate $i$ changes the value of $f$, then $f(x)=x_i$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the $n$-dimensional sign cube to the two signs
